label: managerial leadership in
definition: Person 1 holds or formerly held a managerial leadership office in organization 2.
scope_notes: Director/head family dominates, with chair, president and manager paraphrases. Spokesperson, lawyer or aide alone does not establish leadership; names known-as and geographic relations are competing themes.

facts.reason: McKenzie is explicitly director of Ballet Theater and also appears in a head-of path.
Parcells is identified as coach of the Giants, but the selected managerial office family requires head/director/manager or another explicit management title; coaching alone is a distinct role.
Mucha is a director/manager/adviser for Mr. Pataki, an individual principal. These do not identify an organization as argument 2.
Democrats control the Senate; a political party controlling a legislature is not a person holding a managerial office.
Krens is explicitly director and head of the Guggenheim, with appointment and tenure evidence.
